[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Anne was born on 11 March 1788. She was the natural daughter of [[Glasgow-1076|Robert Glasgow of Montgreenan]] and Annie Swann. On 2 August 1804 in Edinburgh, Midlothian, Anne married [[Robertson-30564|Robert Robertson]]. They had ten children. Anne passed away in France on 29 July 1867.<ref>Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/153319836/anne-robertson: accessed May 18, 2026), memorial page for Anne Glasgow Robertson (11 Mar 1788–29 Jul 1867), Find a Grave Memorial ID 153319836, citing Kilwinning Churchyard, Kilwinning, North Ayrshire, Scotland; Maintained by Pixturmn (contributor 47729036).</ref>

=== Heir of entail ===
Anne's father named her in his trust deed of 30 April 1802 as "Miss Anne Glasgow, my reputed natural daughter by Mrs. Anne Swan", and settled the Montgreenan estate on her and her issue.<ref name="HL1846">House of Lords, ''David Allan and John Smith v. Anne Robertson Glasgow'' (1846), report quoting the 1802 trust deed of Robert Glasgow of Mountgreenan ([https://lawcarenigeria.com/david-allan-and-john-smith-v-anne-robertson-glasgow/ online transcription]).</ref> After his death in 1827 his heirs-at-law challenged his settlements. In August 1835 the House of Lords heard ''Allan v. Glasgow's Trustees'', in which "Mrs Robertson Glasgow" was described as the late Robert Glasgow's natural daughter and first heir under his entail of 1818; the judgment against the appellant Hugh Allan was reversed on 1 September 1835.<ref>''Morning Post'' (London), August 1835, House of Lords report, Hugh Allan v. trustees of Robert Glasgow ([https://www.newspapers.com/image/396909317/ Newspapers.com image 396909317]); ''Morning Chronicle'' (London), September 1835 ([https://www.newspapers.com/image/392120204/ Newspapers.com image 392120204]).</ref> She and her husband, known as Robert Robertson Glasgow, later claimed the Mount Greenan estate on St Vincent.<ref>University College London, Legacies of British Slavery, [https://www.ucl.ac.uk/lbs/claim/view/26620 St Vincent claim 466] and [https://www.ucl.ac.uk/lbs/person/view/27300 Robert Robertson Glasgow].</ref>
